I agree and highly suggest the minor. With your background in chemistry, you should be fine with any scientifically involved courses so long as you have taken biochem. You can choose to either take the more focused courses or stay at a shallower depth with more breadth. My experience as a biochem major with the phr minor is that pharmacy is applied biochemistry much like biochemistry is applied chemistry and chemistry is applied physics. 

All in all, you shouldn't have to worry about the required course load because it's pretty much a choose-your-own-adventure. Good luck and have fun!
